description: [Auth Required] Contract tasks / agent events the agent participates in via the kal_event pivot (any role: Hand=4, Reviewer=5, QA=6) plus benefitable-self fallback. Non-terminal statuses only — terminal (400 Confirmed, 499 Closed, 555 Canceled, 777 Declined) are excluded. Optional filters narrow by status / role / contract. (Renamed from get-my-jobs.)

contract_id.description: Optional contract_id to scope by billable contract.

include_pending.description: Only consulted when statuses is empty. Pass false to hide Pending (100). Default true — backlog visible.

roles.description: Optional list of MY role ids on the task (4 Hand, 5 Reviewer, 6 QA). Omit for "any role I have".

statuses.description: Optional list of status_id values to include (e.g. [222,300] for the QA queue). Omit for "any active". Terminal statuses are ignored.

name: get-my-events
title: Get My Events
